report.method: Actual Workspace raycasts across track width, every segment join, market connection, overshoot area, and floor perimeter. Does not certify rider feel or camera behavior.

findingAndFix.finding: Exact triangle boundaries sometimes returned a vertical wedge side or reached the safety floor. Probes 0.02 studs beside a failing seam found the expected shallow slope.
findingAndFix.fix: Expand each triangle face by 0.8 percent around its centroid so adjacent riding surfaces overlap.
findingAndFix.candidateLoading: Created an isolated temporary ModuleScript from the revised local source, resolving Geometry through ServerScriptService. Ran the installed ParkAcceptance module, then destroyed the isolated folder.

limitations: Checks validate collision support geometry, not steering feel, actual rider traversal, airborne dive timing, or camera behavior.
The revised park builder still needs to be synced into the playable artifact by the integrating agent.
